shadows.name: overlay-only
shadows.value: reserved for floating overlays only (rendered as glassmorphism, not a shadow)
shadows.purpose: Resting content never carries a shadow; floating overlays use glass.

motion.name: header-solidify
motion.purpose: Transparent-to-glass header transition on the homepage.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #e8790a; color: #050b1a; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 16px 32px; font-weight: 600; border: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #f59320; }

narrative.overview: Third rebuild of the visual layer. Same content and logo-derived palette each time; composition rebuilt from scratch per user request. This revision: centered glow-blob hero, transparent-to-glass header, bento services grid, testimonial grid, light footer, rounded-3xl everywhere.
keyCharacteristics: Vivid electric blue dominant field, saturated orange as the sole signal accent
Jura bold for headings, Outfit for body
Full-pill buttons, rounded-3xl everywhere else, no angular shapes

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Orange never fills a background region larger than a button, badge, or the one bento tile.

rules.name: The Single-Face Discipline Rule
rules.body: Only Jura (headings) and Outfit (body/UI) exist on the site.

dos: Do keep amber/orange as the only accent color.
Do keep shapes to full-pill or rounded-3xl only.
donts: Don't use an em dash or en dash anywhere in visible copy.
Don't drive scroll-based state with a raw window.addEventListener("scroll").
